events.line: Rinor benched DK for 14 points when he was only supposed to get 8.5—that's the kind of fucked up decision-making that's gonna haunt you when you're watching from the couch in January.

Adam, I didn't know we were allowed to just fucking *manifest* a breakout performance into existence, but apparently that's what Judkins decided to do this week—absolutely demolished his projection and you're out here looking like a genius for having the balls to start him when everyone else was sleeping on him.
